prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one native transparent RGBA character sprite for the Dossier Curien 2D bestiary gallery. Image 2 is the SEGA manual depiction of the SAME Goldman seated, used only for his clothing and lean adult proportions; adapt him to standing with both legs and plain dark formal shoes fully visible. Image 3 (Isaac) is ONLY the drawing-style reference: readable hand-painted arcade sprite, crisp outlined contours, carefully painted cloth folds, rich restrained shading and natural human anatomy. Do not copy Isaac's face, cap, brown jacket, gun or fighting stance. Goldman is unarmed: dignified tense upright stance, feet slightly apart, one hand lightly adjusting the other cuff in front of his waist. Retain both empty hands, five fingers each where visible, fitted suit, ordinary lapels, no added badges or ornate props. Center one entire figure with clear transparent space on every side and beneath both soles, roughly 85 percent canvas height. True transparent background; no scenery, chair, desk, text, lettering, labels, logo, border, duplicate figure, cropped head or feet. This is a carefully referenced 2D adaptation, not a screenshot or a literal copied polygon render.
